summary: This bill repeals Title II and Subtitle D of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, restoring the prior versions of federal firearms statutes in Title 18, the Brady Act, and related education provisions while eliminating associated NICS funding.

scores.thoughts: The bill eliminates a specific line of funding related to NICS juvenile records expansion. This is a minor, incidental reduction in spending and not a central purpose of the legislation.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, or revenue policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare policy or insurance.

The bill's sole purpose is to repeal the firearm-related provisions of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, explicitly restoring prior law to remove restrictions on firearms and to protect Second Amendment rights. This is a direct and primary engagement with gun policy that moves strongly toward protecting gun rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration or border policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion or reproductive policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulation or climate policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs or social safety net programs.

The bill repeals a subtitle of the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act that amended the ESEA, but this is incidental to the gun-related purpose and does not alter federal education policy in any substantive way beyond removing gun-related language.
The bill contains no provisions related to drug enforcement or decriminalization.
The bill contains no provisions related to sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to trade or tariffs.
The bill contains no provisions related to deficits or debt reduction.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ rights or protections.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access or election integrity.
The bill contains no provisions related to technology regulation or data privacy.
The bill contains no provisions related to labor, unions, or employment policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious liberty or anti-discrimination law.
